positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Became one of the main engineers in the digital transformation process for investment accounts.
- Led the end-to-end implementation of a new digital investment account creation process, reducing manual processing by 90% and client onboarding time from an average of one hour to 15 minutes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Microservices/micro-frontend development, deployment, and maintenance using Angular, Java, and Kubernetes.
- Worked with cross-functional teams to implement innovative digital solutions for account opening processes.
- Engineered and deployed major features for the new online banking lending platform using Java and Angular, which served thousands of daily users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Conducted full-cycle software development including requirements analysis, design, and implementation.
Developed multiple web applications, including e-commerce and process management solutions.
Implemented backend (Java, Hibernate, Spring) and frontend (Angular, TypeScript, HTML, SCSS) projects.
Collaborated in developing a framework to generate code for new projects based on their DB design.
Led a complete project from start to finish receiving more responsibilities during my final months.
